A '''holovid viewer'''<ref name="GA">''[[Graveyard of Alderaan]]''</ref> or '''holovid projector'''<ref name="AP">{{JournalCite|11|The Ando Project}}</ref> was device used to view [[Holovid/Legends|holovids]]. They were generally used for entertainment and relaxation purposes, and could be found in communal areas like the lounge on [[Mining Outpost 11]].<ref name="GA" />
